title: WebKitGTK media-stream/WebRTC status on Tauri Linux (getUserMedia not viable)
notes: Verified live 2026-11-09 (webkitgtk.org, webkit2gtk docs, tauri issues #8851/#2600/#13143, rcq-desktop DESKTOP.md, KittyCAD issue #625). Relevance: Jerry SPEC-VOICE capture-layer decision — Rust cpal, not webview.

sections.heading: Verdict
sections.body: Do NOT architect webview mic capture or webview audio playback on Tauri Linux. Capture = cpal Rust-side; playback = rodio Rust-side; both avoid WebKitGTK version churn and CSP changes.
